topic.title: [Dataset+Notebook] 16 Decks That Actually Won Real Pokémon Tournaments — Ready-to-Use deck.csv

messages.content:
Shared a dataset of 16 real Japanese City League top-cut decks, already converted to this competition's own card-id format (drop-in deck.csv, no conversion needed), plus a notebook that validates legality and breaks down composition/staple cards/type distribution:

🔗 Notebook: https://www.kaggle.com/code/yu0307/16-real-city-league-top-cut-decks-deck-csv

🔗 Dataset: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/yu0307/deck-csv/data

Hope it saves someone some deck-building time.
